tools.name: freightview_get_account_users
tools.description: List the users on the Freightview account behind the API credentials. Freightview API: GET /account/users.

tools.name: freightview_get_account_locations
tools.description: List the saved locations (sites) on the Freightview account. Freightview API: GET /account/locations.

tools.name: freightview_get_account_carriers
tools.description: List the carriers added to the Freightview account (carrier ids used in quotes). Freightview API: GET /account/carriers.

tools.name: freightview_get_carrier
tools.description: Get a carrier's name and its available services by SCAC code. Freightview API: GET /carriers/{scac}.

tools.name: freightview_search_shipments
tools.description: Search shipments on the account, with filters and a continuation token for the next page. Freightview API: GET /shipments.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment: status, locations, items, selected quote, tracking and documents. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment_quotes
tools.description: List the quotes for a shipment, with quoteId, carrier, amount and expiry. Use quoteId to book. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}/quotes.

tools.name: freightview_get_shipment_tracking
tools.description: Get the tracking events of a shipment, optionally for one item. Freightview API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}/tracking.

tools.name: freightview_create_ltl_shipment
tools.description: Create and rate an LTL shipment draft with quotes. Nothing is booked. Book a quote later with freightview_book_ltl_shipment. Freightview API: POST /shipments/ltl.

tools.name: freightview_create_parcel_shipment
tools.description: Create and rate a parcel shipment draft with quotes. Nothing is booked. Book a quote later with freightview_book_parcel_shipment. Freightview API: POST /shipments/parcel.

tools.name: freightview_create_truckload_shipment
tools.description: Create a truckload shipment draft with its stops and equipment. Nothing is awarded or booked. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload.

tools.name: freightview_book_ltl_shipment
tools.description: BOOKS an LTL shipment with a quote, which commits the account to the carrier and its charge. Call only after the user approves this quote and price. Freightview API: POST /shipments/ltl/{shipmentId}/book.

tools.name: freightview_book_ltl_freight_collect
tools.description: BOOKS a customer-routed (freight collect) LTL shipment. The account's own carrier collects the freight. Call only after the user approves it. Freightview API: POST /shipments/ltl/book/freight-collect.

tools.name: freightview_book_parcel_shipment
tools.description: BOOKS a parcel shipment with a quote, which commits the account to the carrier and its charge. Call only after the user approves this quote and price. Freightview API: POST /shipments/parcel/{shipmentId}/book.

tools.name: freightview_book_parcel_freight_collect
tools.description: BOOKS a customer-routed (freight collect) parcel shipment. Call only after the user approves it. Freightview API: POST /shipments/parcel/book/freight-collect.

tools.name: freightview_cancel_ltl_shipment
tools.description: CANCELS an LTL shipment. Call only after the user approves the cancellation. Freightview API: DELETE /shipments/ltl/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: freightview_cancel_parcel_shipment
tools.description: CANCELS a parcel shipment. Call only after the user approves the cancellation. Freightview API: DELETE /shipments/parcel/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: freightview_cancel_truckload_shipment
tools.description: CANCELS a truckload shipment. Call only after the user approves the cancellation. Freightview API: DELETE /shipments/truckload/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: freightview_award_truckload_shipment
tools.description: AWARDS a truckload shipment to the carrier of a quote, which commits the carrier. Call only after the user approves this quote. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload/{shipmentId}/award.

tools.name: freightview_confirm_truckload_shipment
tools.description: CONFIRMS a truckload shipment with the carrier's pickup confirmation number. Call only after the user approves it. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload/{shipmentId}/confirm.

tools.name: freightview_retract_truckload_award
tools.description: RETRACTS an awarded truckload shipment from its carrier. Call only after the user approves it. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload/{shipmentId}/retract.

tools.name: freightview_book_truckload_freight_collect
tools.description: BOOKS a customer-routed (freight collect) truckload shipment with a carrier. Call only after the user approves it. Freightview API: POST /shipments/truckload/freight-collect.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "freightview_get_account_users" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the users on the Freightview account behind the API credentials. Freightview API: GET /account/users.
